verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Loops offers official, typed SDKs ('Add Loops to your application in minutes with our SDKs'; 'REST API and typed SDKs'). Its API skill can 'install an official SDK', and a live OpenAPI spec supports client generation. Missing for 10: which languages or packages the SDKs cover, SDK-specific reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
